entries.description: Setup metadata for connecting an AI assistant to WordPress Playground in the browser using the local @wp-playground/mcp server or browser-native WebMCP tools.
representativeQueries: Connect my AI assistant to a WordPress Playground site in my browser
Inspect a page on my running WordPress Playground site
Debug a WordPress plugin error by running PHP and reading files in a browser sandbox
Check emails sent by a WordPress site and test pages in my browser

entries.description: Guides coding agents through running WordPress locally, previewing sites in the browser, and working with Blueprints and snapshots.
representativeQueries: Reproduce a WordPress plugin bug in a fresh WordPress and PHP environment
Start a local WordPress environment with my plugin mounted
Test my WordPress theme or plugin on a different PHP or WordPress version without Docker
Create a shareable WordPress preview link from a Blueprint
